claims.text: Incorporating inferred user traits into the model helps improve predictions about which activity clusters a user is likely to engage in.
Including user attributes can lead to overfitting, which may deteriorate the model's generalization performance.
The models trained with user traits show improved results compared to random guessing, indicating the feasibility of the task.
